title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
desc: City boy Ram falls for village girl Sona, raised by her strict brother Raghuveer. After Ram's mother insults Sona, Raghuveer challenges Ram to prove he's worthy of marrying her.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Gadar 2
desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

title: Nill Battey Sannata
desc: Apeksha hates studying due to financial struggles. Her mother, Chanda, creates a clever plan to motivate her, turning resistance into ambition and learning into empowerment.

title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
desc: Sanjana is to get married with NRI Prem. However, theres a chaos when she falls in love with his employee Prem Kishen while Prem Kumar is delayed. How will it affect Sanjana?

title: Kanyadaan
desc: Married as children, Rekha and Amar are separated by fate. Years later, shocking truths emerge as Rekha discovers Amar's new marriage and Kumar's hidden identity.

title: Koogle Kuttappa
desc: A conservative villager opposes his son's move to Russia for work, but when the son brings home a robot caregiver, he forms an unexpected bond with the machine.

title: Crew
desc: Three cabin crew friends find themselves in a tough spot when an unknown schemer throws a wrench in their plans. Can they uncover the truth and save the day?

title: Krrish 3
desc: Krrish faces a new threat: Kaal, an evil genius causing global destruction. Krrish and his father must unite to stop him, testing their family's strength.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Love Hostel
desc: Amidst bloodshed, deception, and desperate escapes, Jyothi and Ashu elope, prompting her family to hire a ruthless mercenary to hunt them down and end their love.
